questions.question: What does Micah 4 say about the mountain of the LORD's house?
options: It shall be utterly torn down and left in ruins forever and ever more
It shall be wholly forgotten by all of the nations of the earth
It shall be established as the highest, and peoples shall flow to it
It shall be hidden far away from the searching eyes of the proud
questions.answer: It shall be established as the highest, and peoples shall flow to it

questions.question: What image of peace does Micah 4 share (like Isaiah 2)?
options: Building up very high walls and great gates made all of bronze
Forging the plowshares back into sharp swords for the coming war
Beating swords into plowshares and spears into pruning hooks
Raising up great and mighty armies among all of the nations
questions.answer: Beating swords into plowshares and spears into pruning hooks

questions.question: Micah 4 says each one shall sit under his vine and fig tree, and none shall make them afraid.
They shall beat their swords into _____, and their spears into pruning hooks.
They shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig _____.
